description: This file defines a React component 'ServiceRequestsPage' which manages the display and creation of service requests within a web application. It includes state management for fetching and submitting service request data, user authentication context, and rendering UI elements such as tables and forms.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches the list of service requests from the backend API and updates the component state.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles form submission to create a new service request via the backend API and refreshes the list.
